noise_only.label: Noise-only
noise_only.description: complex Gaussian observation noise, SNR 10/20/30/40 dB, no drift, no missing observations

drift_5ppm.label: Drift-only 5 ppm
drift_5ppm.description: fixed 5 ppm frequency-axis drift plus SNR sweep, no missing observations

missing_5_10pct.label: Missing observations 5-10%
missing_5_10pct.description: 5% and 10% missing sparse observations plus SNR sweep, no frequency drift

notes: Multiple comparisons are descriptive; no p-value significance claims are made.
Matched-pair win rates are reported to reduce aggregate-composition fallacy risk.
Curve-stratified summaries are reported to avoid Simpson-style overinterpretation.
No causal claim is made beyond controlled perturbation effects within this experimental benchmark.
